scope: calibration only; diagnostic snapshots; no application/profile/model/configuration changes

candidate_definitions.description: Split each original VAD span into baseline-compatible balanced continuous blocks of at most8seconds (span shorter than3seconds remains one block). Reject any nonfinite, RMS<1e-4 or clipping>0.05 block before counting or packing. Concatenate retained chronological sample blocks once, without inserted samples; divide total sample count into ceil(total/(8*sample_rate)) balanced, nonoverlapping integer-boundary windows, rejecting packed totals below3seconds; keep the existing maximum20window subsampling, window-quality, consistency and pooling rules.

Return the exact baseline evidence object when it already satisfies the operation purpose, or when baseline reason is inconsistent_voice_windows. Only when the baseline is purpose-insufficient and at least one original VAD span is shorter than3seconds, try pack_all_voiced. Accept fallback only when its unchanged purpose/quality/consistency requirements pass. If a baseline partial embedding exists, additionally require cosine(packed,baseline)>=0.55; otherwise keep rejection. All originally accepted and inconsistent baseline outcomes remain unchanged.

window_independence: Sample-disjoint windows only; no claim of independent speakers or recording sessions
compatibility: Candidate query embeddings compared to the original baseline-usable40 enrollment profile embeddings; failed baseline profiles remain absent and every planned query remains in denominators. Also report results restricted to baseline-covered people.
negative_pair_selection: First20 gallery speakers whose enrollment passed the previously recorded baseline, fixed before candidate scoring.
wrong_person_append: For each pair(A,B), use full B enrollment audio as a hypothetical append into existing baseline profile A. Apply candidate enrollment-quality rules and the existing recognized/top-target guard against the fixed40profile baseline gallery; no database writes.
mixed_alternating: For each pair(A,B), alternate disjoint2second chunks from the first16seconds of each enrollment waveform: A0:2,B0:2,...,A14:16,B14:16, yielding32seconds. No repeated samples or added silence. Run baseline and both candidates with enrollment purpose; report quality acceptance and baseline-gallery decision separately. Passing a mixed clip is not counted as a successful negative test.
held_out_policy: Never load test.json or held-out audio/results during selection. All scores are calibration diagnostics, not new live application evidence.
amendment_reason: Parent input-quality boundary requirement from deterministic TDD before any model scoring: pre-filter original VAD blocks to prevent poor samples being diluted into packed windows. Candidate count and score policy unchanged.

supplemental_gapped_negative_protocol.scope: Supplemental calibration-only negative stress test; no candidate changes; frozen before reading first diagnostic scores
supplemental_gapped_negative_protocol.definition: First8seconds of each pair enrollment waveform, alternate disjoint2second A and B chunks for4cycles, inserting0.4seconds zeros after every chunk except the final one. Total18.8seconds. Inserted silence is a negative input fixture only and never counted as speech; candidate itself inserts no samples. Quality acceptance of a mixed-person enrollment is a failed negative regardless of identity decision.
